-- 2018 projects

-- Hairspray
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Hairspray' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2018', '1960s', 'Civil Rights', 'Comedy', 'Baltimore')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Into the Woods
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Into the Woods' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2018', 'Stephen Sondheim', 'Fairy Tale', 'Dark Comedy', 'Ensemble')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- 2017 projects

-- The Music Man
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Music Man' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2017', 'Classic Musical', 'Iowa', 'Americana', 'Family Show')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Grease
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Grease' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2017', '1950s', 'High School', 'Rock and Roll', 'Nostalgia')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
